en: The image is a vintage-style painted postcard depicting a lively urban square or promenade near a body of water, likely a bay or harbor. The scene is shaded by trees and features a prominent ornate fountain at the center. People in period attire, including women wearing traditional Galician headgear, are gathering water or socializing. In the background, horse-drawn carriages and an early tram can be seen, suggesting a late 19th or early 20th-century setting. The lower left corner bears the text 'VIGO' and 'Biblioteca de Galicia Falpena', with a signature 'Oulete' or similar in the bottom right.
